metadata.title: Retro Band Collage with Torn Paper Effect

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered collage featuring a high-contrast group portrait set against a dark background, bisected by a white torn-paper edge that reveals a secondary textured footer.
triggerTerms: gradient display type with thick outlines

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image featuring a group of men in semi-formal attire, rendered in high-contrast photography with deep shadows. The top section contains large, stylized gradient text with heavy outlines. The bottom third is separated by a jagged, white torn-paper texture, revealing a patterned background and bold, slanted secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast figures against a void-like black background
Horizontal division via a tactile torn-paper edge
Vibrant gradient display type contrasting with monochromatic photography
Repetitive watermark pattern in the footer section

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a staggered, overlapping group occupying the central and upper-mid frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vibrant display text at the top and the white torn-paper line across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, moves down through the faces of the subjects, and rests on the bold text in the footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounding the subjects in the upper two-thirds.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and white paper tear; high saturation in the top text against desaturated photography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, multi-layered outlines (white then blue)
Secondary text is heavily italicized/slanted with irregular brush-like edges
Primary text features a vertical linear gradient
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or tightly kerned characters in the top display line

treatment.outline: thick white inner, thin blue outer

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact gradient sans-serif paired with a distressed, slanted brush script for a 'DIY' or 'grunge' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the top display text.
Captures the aggressive, hand-drawn feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast group portrait of five men in suits and dark shirts against a black background. Add a horizontal white torn-paper edge across the bottom third, revealing a light blue textured area with a faint repeating pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large gradient text (pink to orange) with thick white and blue outlines at the top. Add bold, black, slanted brush-style text in the center of the bottom textured area.

verificationChecks: Is the torn paper edge jagged and white?
Does the top text have a multi-layered outline?
Is the photography high-contrast with deep shadows?
Is the bottom text slanted and distressed?

adjustableVariables: Gradient colors of the top text
Number of subjects in the portrait
Intensity of the torn paper distress
Pattern used in the footer background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the torn edge looks like physical paper, not a clean line.
Check that the gradient in the top text is smooth.
Verify the background pattern in the footer is subtle and repetitive.
Confirm the subjects are well-integrated into the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + black void background + gradient outlined display type + torn paper footer + slanted brush script.
